risks.proof: A video clip showing the keyboard powered on, keys being pressed, and sound output, or a photo of the power cord and outlet connection.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear not visible in photos, such as internal circuitry issues, broken key mechanisms, or speaker failure.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the underside or internal components, or a video demonstrating all keys and functions.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case, assuming partial or full malfunction

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, stand, or sustain pedal) that may be expected with the keyboard.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

Photo of the power adapter and any included accessories.
